A YouTuber in Northern Ireland who faked a livestream to cover his tracks as he murdered his pregnant girlfriend was jailed for life on Wednesday, June 3. Stephen McCullagh was sentenced to a minimum of 31 years in prison, one of the longest jail terms ever handed down in Northern Ireland, for killing Natalie McNally in her home the week before Christmas in 2022. She was 32 years old and 15 weeks pregnant when she was murdered. McCullagh set up what looked like a plausible YouTube livestream in which he was playing video games to broadcast as he traveled to McNally’s home. A day later, he pretended to discover her body and “masqueraded as a distraught and caring partner,” police said. He was arrested at the scene and initially released. But after a long investigation, cyber-crime officers found “irrefutable evidence” to show the livestream “had in fact been pre-recorded several days earlier.” Footage released by police, and made available here, shows a portion of the fake livestream; McCullagh’s arrest; the moment police revealed they knew the stream was fake; key security footage that caught him boarding a bus to McNally’s hometown on the night of the murder; and photographs of McCullagh and McNally available for media use. The UN's new Scientific Panel on AI was established to equip "governments to grapple with the most transformative technology of our time," writes expert Tony Oweke. But its success hinges on striking the right balance between independence, expertise, and political legitimacy, he argues. "The central dilemma for any science–policy interface is that excessive government involvement can compromise scientific credibility, while complete isolation from governments can render scientific findings irrelevant to policymakers." AI research is also "heavily funded by industry," Oweke writes, "creating an incentive structure that is overwhelmingly skewed toward commercial applications at the expense of research on societal implications." Four of the panel's 40 experts hold primary positions at U.S. big tech firms—some of which have been accused of suppressing unfavorable research by their employees. When the balance between political legitimacy and scientific credibility is achieved, Oweke argues, "collective action can be galvanized to address humanity's most pressing challenges." When it isn't, "institutions lose authority and wither."

El nadador británico Rob Howens se encontraba en el agua junto a su pequeña hija frente a la Isla Norte de Nueva Zelanda cuando, de manera inesperada, un grupo de delfines comenzó a rodearlos. De acuerdo con testigos y socorristas, los delfines formaron un círculo muy cerrado a su alrededor y, una y otra vez, los fueron guiando hacia la orilla. Poco después, se detectó la presencia de un tiburón blanco de aproximadamente tres metros de longitud. Durante unos 30 a 40 minutos, los delfines mantuvieron la formación, utilizando fuertes golpes de cola y movimientos coordinados para mantener al tiburón a distancia. Solo se alejaron cuando el depredador desapareció, permitiendo que padre e hija regresaran sanos y salvos. Este episodio es considerado uno de los ejemplos más sorprendentes de la inteligencia social de los delfines y de su extraordinaria capacidad para actuar de forma coordinada en la protección de los seres humanos.

Bangladesh: Killing of Local Political Activist Raises Serious Human Rights Concerns The killing of a local political activist in Jashore has renewed concerns about political violence, impunity, and the protection of fundamental human rights in Bangladesh. Jewel Rana, a member of the Patibila Union Youth League, died on 11 June after being severely injured in an attack in Chowgacha Upazila, according to police and hospital officials. Family members have accused local activists associated with the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) of carrying out the assault, while police say preliminary investigations suggest the incident stemmed from a political dispute. Regardless of political affiliation, the right to life is a fundamental human right protected under both Bangladesh’s Constitution and international human rights law. The brutal nature of the attack, as described by witnesses and relatives, underscores the urgent need for a thorough, impartial, and transparent investigation. Human rights principles require that allegations of politically motivated violence be investigated without bias and that all suspects be afforded due process under the law. At the same time, victims and their families are entitled to justice, truth, and effective remedies. The incident has also drawn attention to broader concerns about retaliatory violence following political transitions. Human rights advocates have repeatedly warned that cycles of revenge, intimidation, and politically motivated attacks undermine the rule of law and contribute to a climate of fear within communities. Particularly troubling are allegations made by the victim’s family regarding the treatment of Jewel Rana during the attack. Family members claim he was denied assistance while seriously injured and that his wife was assaulted while attempting to protect him. These allegations have not been independently verified, but if substantiated, they would represent grave violations of human dignity and basic humanitarian standards. The case highlights the importance of ensuring equal protection under the law for all citizens, irrespective of their political beliefs or affiliations. Human rights organizations have long maintained that political differences must never be settled through violence. Authorities have stated that several individuals have been questioned and that efforts are ongoing to arrest those responsible. Human rights observers will likely monitor whether the investigation is conducted independently and whether those found responsible are held accountable through legal processes. As Bangladesh continues to navigate political tensions, this case serves as a reminder that justice, accountability, and respect for human rights remain essential to preventing further violence and protecting democratic values. The protection of life, security, and political freedoms must apply equally to every citizen, regardless of party affiliation. #Bangladesh

No acumulado dos últimos dez meses, a queda é de 37,5% em relação ao mesmo período anterior, e o menor valor já registrado na série histórica. ✅ No cerrado, queda de 12,2% em relação a maio de 2025, e de 25,3% em relação a maio de 2024. A redução no acumulado dos últimos dez meses é de 8,2% em relação ao mesmo período de 2024/25, e de 28,8% em relação ao período em 23/24. The UN's new Scientific Panel on AI was established to equip "governments to grapple with the most transformative technology of our time," writes expert Tony Oweke. But its success hinges on striking the right balance between independence, expertise, and political legitimacy, he argues. "The central dilemma for any science–policy interface is that excessive government involvement can compromise scientific credibility, while complete isolation from governments can render scientific findings irrelevant to policymakers." AI research is also "heavily funded by industry," Oweke writes, "creating an incentive structure that is overwhelmingly skewed toward commercial applications at the expense of research on societal implications." Four of the panel's 40 experts hold primary positions at U.S. big tech firms—some of which have been accused of suppressing unfavorable research by their employees. When the balance between political legitimacy and scientific credibility is achieved, Oweke argues, "collective action can be galvanized to address humanity's most pressing challenges." When it isn't, "institutions lose authority and wither."

Tragic loss. He was one of the greatest historians of the United States - his books are monumental achievements. Joshua Claybourn (@JoshuaClaybourn) On Sunday, my friend Gordon Wood was struck and killed in a car accident. Gordon taught history at Brown Univ. and was among the most accomplished historians America has produced. He won the 1993 Pulitzer Prize for The Radicalism of the American Revolution, and his earlier book The Creation of the American Republic, 1776–1787 took the 1970 Bancroft Prize. He also received the National Humanities Medal. He was, in my view, the finest historian of America's founding—which makes it all the sadder that he did not live to see the nation's 250th birthday. His reputation reached popular culture, too. Matt Damon's character in Good Will Hunting invokes him by name in the famous bar scene, accusing a Harvard student of simply "regurgitating Gordon Wood, talking about [...] the pre-Revolutionary utopia and the capital-forming effects of military mobilization." I feel fortunate to have collaborated with Gordon on several projects. In a 2019 anthology I compiled, he wrote an essay on the possibility of a shared American narrative. He centered his argument on equal rights as "the most radical and most powerful ideological force" the Revolution unleashed. "This powerful sense of equality is still alive and well in America," he wrote, "and despite all of its disturbing and unsettling consequences, it is what makes us one people." When I needed jacket blurbs for my new book Lincoln's Compass, coming out this November, I turned to Gordon. The fit was natural: the book argues that Abraham Lincoln took the Declaration's claim that "all men are created equal" as his guiding moral compass—and that he refocused the nation on that claim. Gordon, ever the gentleman, offered generous praise. He was, in many respects, the dean of American historians. He will be very hard to replace. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/JoshuaClaybourn/status/2064004880428089607#m

Bangladesh: Killing of Local Political Activist Raises Serious Human Rights Concerns The killing of a local political activist in Jashore has renewed concerns about political violence, impunity, and the protection of fundamental human rights in Bangladesh. Jewel Rana, a member of the Patibila Union Youth League, died on 11 June after being severely injured in an attack in Chowgacha Upazila, according to police and hospital officials. Family members have accused local activists associated with the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) of carrying out the assault, while police say preliminary investigations suggest the incident stemmed from a political dispute. Regardless of political affiliation, the right to life is a fundamental human right protected under both Bangladesh’s Constitution and international human rights law. The brutal nature of the attack, as described by witnesses and relatives, underscores the urgent need for a thorough, impartial, and transparent investigation. Human rights principles require that allegations of politically motivated violence be investigated without bias and that all suspects be afforded due process under the law. At the same time, victims and their families are entitled to justice, truth, and effective remedies. The incident has also drawn attention to broader concerns about retaliatory violence following political transitions. Human rights advocates have repeatedly warned that cycles of revenge, intimidation, and politically motivated attacks undermine the rule of law and contribute to a climate of fear within communities. Particularly troubling are allegations made by the victim’s family regarding the treatment of Jewel Rana during the attack. Family members claim he was denied assistance while seriously injured and that his wife was assaulted while attempting to protect him. These allegations have not been independently verified, but if substantiated, they would represent grave violations of human dignity and basic humanitarian standards. The case highlights the importance of ensuring equal protection under the law for all citizens, irrespective of their political beliefs or affiliations. Human rights organizations have long maintained that political differences must never be settled through violence. Authorities have stated that several individuals have been questioned and that efforts are ongoing to arrest those responsible. Human rights observers will likely monitor whether the investigation is conducted independently and whether those found responsible are held accountable through legal processes. As Bangladesh continues to navigate political tensions, this case serves as a reminder that justice, accountability, and respect for human rights remain essential to preventing further violence and protecting democratic values. The protection of life, security, and political freedoms must apply equally to every citizen, regardless of party affiliation. #Bangladesh

On 22 May 2026, Dr Pushpa Pathak spoke at a networking event titled, “Rural-Urban Linkages of Small Towns Transformation and Sustainability,” organised by the CPR, in partnership with the Permanent Mission of the Republic of Kenya to the United Nations, UN ESCAP, and Asian Development Bank (ADB). This event brought together experiences from India and beyond on rural-urban linkages that support rural transformation in multiple ways and to explore how this ‘synergy’ can be strengthened to promote sustainable rural and urban development. You can read more details here. lnkd.in/g7bN3jbA Dr Champaka Rajagopal (Fellow, CPR) also contributed to several discussions at the WUF13. On 20 May 2026, Dr Rajagopal organised and facilitated a session titled, “Blended Finance Mechanism Design: Aligning Institutional Accountabilities and Risks for Affordable Housing,” organised by the Urban School, Sciences Po, The Entrepreneurship and Partnerships Lab, and CPR, Delhi. Bringing together experts on housing finance from India, Kenya, Colombia, Brazil, and France, this panel examined how blended finance mechanisms and public-private partnerships in affordable housing can be more equitably structured, ensuring risks are better mitigated, and that low-income communities remain at the centre of housing policy design and implementation. A fortnight ago, Vijay Gokhale observed that China sees Indian democracy as a long-term ideological problem. The Chinese commentary that followed went to lengths explaining why India does not matter, why Indian democracy is a curse, and why Indian aspirations exceed Indian means. That vehemence is a tell in itself. Indifference does not produce it. That India even manages to function at this scale, with this civilisational depth, absorbing its contradictions with a democratic polity, worries Beijing far more than it is willing to admit. Even after decades of neutralising democratic experiments in China's near abroad (read Hong Kong), the CCP has no template to explain India to its own citizens. «دادگاه دائمی مردمی» مستقر در رم، تصمیم اتحادیه اروپا برای دعوت از یک هیأت فنی طالبان به بروکسل برای گفت‌وگو در مورد اخراج مهاجران به افغانستان را محکوم کرده و خواستار لغو آن شده است. این دادگاه امروز (پنج‌شنبه، ۲۱ جوزا) با نشر اعلامیه‌ای گفته است که «تصمیم اتحادیه اروپا گامی خطرناک در جهت عادی‌سازی روابط با رژیمی است که مسئول آپارتاید جنسیتی، نقض‌ سیستماتیک و نهادینه‌شده‌ی حقوق‌بشر، و نابودی تمامی آزادی‌های اساسی زنان افغانستان است.» «دادگاه دائمی مردمی» افزوده است، اگرچه اتحادیه اروپا طالبان ذا به عنوان «دولت بالفعل و مشروع» به رسمیت نمی‌شناسد، اما این تصمیم با اصول اعلام‌شده‌‌ی حقوق‌بشری اتحادیه اروپا در تضاد است و به حمایت از رژیم‌های توتالیتر در زمانی‌که با منافع اتحادیه اروپا همسو باشند، کمک می‌کند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/255284

A horrific stabbing incident in #Belfast this week showed something every investigator, journalist, analyst, and security professional should understand: Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) is no longer optional. Starting with a single BBC News article and a few basic Google searches, I was able to move quickly into ShadowDragon Horizon and begin mapping the publicly available online footprint connected to the suspect arrested in this case. In under 25 minutes, the picture started to form: Public social media presence. Profiles and connections. Posts, comments, and visible relationships. People online claiming to know him or be connected to him. Signals that help investigators understand context, networks, and possible relevance. That is the power of #OSINT. Not hacking. Not guessing. Not “doxxing.” Just disciplined collection, verification, and analysis of publicly available information. Cases like this are also a reminder of how fast information (and misinformation) moves after a violent incident. Within hours, narratives form. Anger spreads. Online claims become fuel. Communities can be put at risk. That is why responsible OSINT matters. Tools like ShadowDragon Horizon do not replace judgment, tradecraft, or ethics. They amplify them. They help investigators move from scattered fragments to structured intelligence: entities, links, timelines, networks, and context. The lesson is not simply that “you can find someone online.” The lesson is that, when used responsibly, OSINT can help us understand the wider information environment around a serious incident before speculation takes over. In modern investigations, the first crime scene is often physical. The second one is online. We must keep in mind two attitudes in our Christian life in order to be “wise architects” in building the civilization of love. The first guiding principle is to take up the cross of Christ as Good Samaritans, accompanying and helping to carry the burdens of so many brothers and sisters who are crucified by life’s trials. The second principle is to cultivate a Eucharistic spirituality, a spirituality of ecclesial unity in love.

While there is a right to seek refuge when life is threatened, there is also the right not to have to migrate: the right to remain in one’s own home without hunger, war, persecution, violence, the land becoming uninhabitable, corruption stealing the bread from the poor, or weapons destroying the future of children. #ApostolicJourney

Every boat that arrives brings a question along with the migrants: what kind of world have we built, if so many brothers and sisters must risk death to seek life? Human dignity demands legal and safe pathways, rescue and assistance, real cooperation against traffickers, effective protection for victims, serious processes of reception and integration, and policies that allow every person to live with dignity in their own land. We cannot grow accustomed to counting the dead. Human dignity has no passport and does not lose its value when crossing a border. #ApostolicJourney

Do the rule of law, press freedom, freedom of expression, democracy, and even the truth still matter? Or is what truly matters simply who is connected to whom? Consider the #UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) fact-finding report on the July–August 2024 unrest in Bangladesh. The report stated that approximately 1,400 people were killed during the violence. Media outlets around the world widely cited this figure, yet few appeared to question how the OHCHR arrived at that number. To date, the @UNHumanRights has not publicly provided a complete list of names or identities corresponding to the reported fatalities. Meanwhile, both the Yunus administration and the subsequent Tarique government have reportedly identified around 834 victims so far, despite nearly two years having passed since the events. This raises an obvious question: who are the remaining individuals included in the OHCHR’s reported total? What is even more troubling is that when a UN representative was asked whether she had personally reviewed the underlying evidence supporting the report’s conclusions, she responded that because the findings came from another UN department—essentially their colleagues—they accepted the figures on that basis. Such an approach, if accurately characterized, would represent a serious failure of scrutiny and accountability. If the 1,400-death figure has indeed been shown to be inaccurate, then the credibility of the report and the institutions involved must be subjected to rigorous examination. The pursuit of truth should require evidence, transparency, and verification—not unquestioning acceptance based on institutional relationships. For many observers, this raises concerns about whether some officials within the OHCHR, particularly under the office of @volker_turk, contributed to the spread of a narrative that may not withstand factual scrutiny. These questions deserve clear answers. Accountability, transparency, and truth should apply equally to international organizations, governments, and all institutions that claim to defend human rights and democratic values. Of the 834 individuals whose identities have reportedly been established, a genuinely impartial investigation into each case could have helped determine the actual circumstances and causes of death. This raises an important question: why has there not been an independent investigation into even a single case over the past two years? Some may wonder whether a thorough and transparent inquiry would reveal facts that challenge prevailing narratives about the events of July. If the true causes of these deaths were established through credible investigations, it could provide a clearer understanding of what actually occurred and allow competing claims to be evaluated against evidence rather than speculation and the established narrative. The absence of such investigations fuels concerns that important facts remain undisclosed. A proper examination of the evidence could either validate or undermine the claims made by those who continue to invoke the legacy of “July,” and that only an independent, fact-based process can resolve these questions and bring greater clarity to the public. That’s why I sometimes wonder whether the truth really matters, or whether everything is ultimately about controlling the narrative, regardless of how much it is based on falsehoods. -Mohammad Ali Arafat Video

आज हम एक ऐतिहासिक पल के साक्षी बन रहे हैं। आज भारत के लोकतांत्रिक इतिहास में एक ऐतिहासिक अध्याय जुड़ा है। हमारे प्रिय नेता प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी ने 62 वर्षों पुराना रिकॉर्ड तोड़ते हुए देश के सबसे लंबे समय तक सेवा देने वाले निर्वाचित प्रधानमंत्री बनने का गौरव प्राप्त किया है। बिना थके, बिना रुके और बिना कोई दाग के मोदी जी का कार्यकाल बहुत ही प्रशंसनीय है। उनकी स्थिरता, निरंतरता और निर्णायक नेतृत्व भारतीय इतिहास का स्वर्णिम कालखंड है। मोदी जी ने गुरु नानक देव जी के "सत्ता को सेवा" तथा "संविधान को प्रशासन का धर्मग्रंथ" मानने के आदर्शों और गुरु रामदास जी के निष्काम कर्मयोगी के संदेश को "प्रधानसेवक" बनकर चरितार्थ करने का काम किया है। उन्होंने 'उपभोग शून्य स्वामी' की कल्पना को चरितार्थ करके हमेशा राष्ट्र प्रथम के भाव को आगे बढ़ाया है। प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी के 12 वर्षों में देश के अनेक भूले-बिसरे स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों और राष्ट्रीय नायकों को सम्मान मिला। उन्होंने दशकों पुरानी नक्सलवाद, आतंकवाद और धारा 370 आदि की समस्या को 12 वर्षों में समाप्त किया। आज भारत, दुनिया की पांचवीं सबसे बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्था बन गया है और विकास के हर क्षेत्र में तेजी से आगे बढ़ रहा है। चाहे महिला सशक्तिकरण की बात हो, किसानों या युवाओं की सशक्तिकरण की बात हो... हर वर्ग का विकास हुआ है। आज कोई भी क्षेत्र विकास से अछूता नहीं है। यही नहीं, मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में भारत आज crisis management का वैश्विक मॉडल बनकर उभरा है, जिसका विश्वभर में शोध हो रहा है। मोदी जी का एक साधारण परिवार से निकलकर 25 वर्षों तक लगातार जनता का विश्वास प्राप्त करना... भारतीय लोकतंत्र की सबसे बड़ी ताकत का प्रमाण है। यह केवल एक रिकॉर्ड नहीं, बल्कि 140 करोड़ देशवासियों के विश्वास, संकल्प और आकांक्षाओं की विजय है। - श्री @AmitShah, केन्द्रीय गृह एवं सहकारिता मंत्री Video

नीती आयोगाच्या बैठकीत महाराष्ट्राच्या प्रगतीचा रोड मॅप सादर पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली राष्ट्रपती भवन, नवी दिल्ली येथे आयोजित ‘नीती आयोगाच्या गव्हर्निंग कौन्सिल’च्या 11व्या बैठकीत मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस सहभागी झाले. यावेळी त्यांनी विकसित महाराष्ट्राच्या संकल्पनेला बळ देणारा सर्वसमावेशक विकासाचा रोडमॅप सादर केला. ‘विकसित भारत 2047’ या संकल्पनेच्या पूर्ततेसाठी शिक्षण, आरोग्य, कौशल्य विकास, महिला सक्षमीकरण आणि सर्वसमावेशक मानवी विकास या पाच प्रमुख क्षेत्रांवर राज्य शासन विशेष भर देत असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. 'विकसित महाराष्ट्र-2047' अंतर्गत 2030 पर्यंत $1 ट्रिलियन, 2035 पर्यंत $2 ट्रिलियन आणि 2047 पर्यंत $5 ट्रिलियन अर्थव्यवस्था उभी करण्याचे उद्दिष्ट असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, महाराष्ट्रात राष्ट्रीय शैक्षणिक धोरण 2020 (NEP) ची प्रभावी अंमलबजावणी, एआय, रोबोटिक्स, डेटा सायन्स आणि ब्लॉकचेनसारख्या आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाचा शिक्षणात समावेश, नवी मुंबई येथे जागतिक दर्जाची ‘एज्युसिटी’, तसेच कौशल्य विकास, स्टार्टअप्स आणि उद्योजकतेला प्रोत्साहन देणारी धोरणे राबविण्यात येत आहेत. तसेच, आरोग्य क्षेत्रात आयुष्मान भारत आणि महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले जनआरोग्य योजनेचा विस्तार, नवीन वैद्यकीय महाविद्यालये आणि मेडिसिटीसारख्या संकल्पना राबविण्यात येत आहेत. महिला सक्षमीकरणासाठी ‘उमेद’ अभियान आणि मुख्यमंत्री माझी लाडकी बहीण योजना राबविली जात आहे. कृषी, उद्योग, पर्यटन, डिजिटल प्रशासन आणि एआयसारख्या क्षेत्रातील उपक्रमांमुळे राज्याच्या प्रगतीला नवी गती मिळत आहे, तसेच महाराष्ट्र देशाच्या विकासात अग्रणी भूमिका बजावत राहील, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. @narendramodi @Dev_Fadnavis @NITIAayog #ViksitBharat2047 #GoverningCouncil #ViksitMaharashtra2047 #DevendraFadnavis

دونالد ترامپ، رییس‌جمهور امریکا تهدید کرده است که ایالات متحده امشب ‌«ضربه‌ی بسیار سختی» به ایران خواهد زد. او همچنین گفته است که در آینده‌ی نزدیک امریکا جزیره خارک و سایر نقاط زیرساخت نفتی ایران را نیز تصرف خواهد کرد. او امروز (پنج‌شنبه، ۲۱ جوزا) در پیامی در تروث‌سوشیال نوشته است: «ایالات متحده امشب به ایران (که نیروی دریایی، نیروی هوایی، رادار، پدافند هوایی و تمام اشکال دیگر دفاع آن، به همراه بیشتر توانایی تهاجمی‌اش، از بین رفته است) ضربه‌ی بسیار سختی خواهد زد. در مقطعی در آینده‌ای نه چندان دور، ما جزیره خارک و سایر نقاط زیرساخت نفتی را تصرف خواهیم کرد و کنترل کامل بازارهای نفت و گاز آن‌ها را به‌دست خواهیم گرفت. دقیقا مانند کاری که با ونزوئلا انجام دادیم، که به طرز درخشانی هم برای ونزوئلا و هم برای ایالات متحده امریکا نتیجه می‌دهد.» بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/255277

مجتبی خامنه‌ای، رهبر ایران با نشر پیامی، درگذشت آیت‌الله محمداسحاق فیاض، از مراجع تقلید برجسته‌ی شیعیان جهان را به «حوزه نجف اشرف و عموم مقلدان و ارادتمندان آن مرجع فقید، به‌ویژه به ملت مقاوم و نستوه افغانستان و خاندان معزز ایشان» تسلیت گفته است. به گزارش خبرگزاری فارس، مجتبی خامنه‌ای در این پیام مکتوب گفته است که درگذشت آیت‌الله فیاض حوزه‌های علمیه، به‌ویژه حوزه نجف را در سوگ نشانده است. رهبر ایران افزوده است: «سال‌ها حضور در حوزه مقدسه‌ی نجف اشرف و کسب فیض از محضر بزرگان آن، ‌چون مرحوم آیت‌الله سید ابوالقاسم خویی و تربیت شاگردان و تألیف کتب و اشراف بر جریان علمی آن حوزه و ارشاد مؤمنین و مقلدان، تنها بخشی از خدمات وجود این فقیه بود که فراموش نخواهد شد و آثار صالحه‌ی آن باقی خواهد ماند.» بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/255275

Professional surfer Matt Wilkinson had a close encounter with a shark while surfing near Ballina, New South Wales, on Wednesday, October 7. A Surf Life Saving NSW drone alerted Wilkinson with a recorded message as the shark circled near him off Sharpes Beach. “I was surfing out the back at Sharpes Beach and just cruising on my own and I heard a splash and a noise and looked around and couldn’t see anything,” said Wilkinson. “Then the drone came down and told me that there was a dangerous shark in the area, return to the beach. “I got to the shore feeling a bit weird and the lifeguards showed me the footage and I realised how close it came without knowing it was there. It looks like it’s going for my leg and it’s changed its mind,” he added. The beach was closed after the incident. Drone operator Beau Monks said he’d just launched his seventh drone flight of the day when he spotted the shark near Wilkinson. “It sort of came out of nowhere, then went right up to Matt. It moved pretty fast. I was tracking it and notified the lifeguards and used the speaker on the drone to get everyone out of the water. Within 10 seconds it was at the surfer and five seconds later it was gone,” said Beau Monks. Surf Life Saving NSW operates drones at 34 beaches across New South Wales. Video

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, this afternoon met with H.E. Christopher Landau, the United States’ Deputy Secretary of State, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Both sides discussed ways to further advance the ASEAN-United States Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP), including initiatives to commemorate the 50th anniversary of ASEAN-US Dialogue Relations and the 5th anniversary of the ASEAN-US Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP) in 2027. They also exchanged views on regional and global developments, as well as other topics of mutual interest.

ASEAN and the EU reviewed the progress of cooperation and exchanged views on potential areas of future cooperation during the 33rd Meeting of the ASEAN-EU Joint Cooperation Committee, held today at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. The Meeting was co-chaired by the Permanent Representative of Brunei Darussalam to ASEAN, H.E. Latifah Zaini, and the Head of Southeast Asia and ASEAN Division at the European External Action Service, Ms. Leila Fernández-Stembridge, together with the Acting Head of Unit for South and South-East Asia at the European Commission Directorate-General for International Partnerships, Mr. Ian Hoskins. Permanent Representatives of ASEAN Member States or their representatives and the staff of the ASEAN Secretariat attended the meeting.

The Ambassador of the United States of America to ASEAN, H.E. Kevin Kim, today presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Kim on the commencement of his tenure and reaffirmed the importance of the ASEAN-United States (U.S.) Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in advancing peace, stability, and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific region. He highlighted the U.S.’s longstanding engagement with ASEAN and appreciated its unwavering support for ASEAN Centrality and ASEAN Community-building efforts, regional economic integration, digital transformation, and development initiatives. Secretary-General Dr. Kao underscored the significance of ASEAN-led mechanisms, including the East Asia Summit (EAS), ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF), and the ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus), in fostering dialogue, mutual trust, and cooperation on regional and global issues of common concern. He highlighted that the U.S. has been a steadfast partner and actively participated in these mechanisms. Ambassador Kim reaffirmed the United States’ support for ASEAN centrality and expressed readiness to deepen cooperation in support of the ASEAN-United States Leaders’ Joint Vision Statement to Promote Stronger, Safer, and More Prosperous ASEAN and America adopted in 2025. Ambassador Kim noted the United States is a proud Pacific nation and highlighted opportunities for expanded partnership to advance a free and open Indo-Pacific that benefits our combined one billion people. He also welcomed the upcoming 50th anniversary of ASEAN-U.S. Dialogue Relations in 2027. The U.S. became a Dialogue Partner of ASEAN in 1977 and established a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with ASEAN in 2022. Reflecting its longstanding commitment to ASEAN, the U.S. appointed its first Ambassador to ASEAN in 2008 and established its dedicated Mission to ASEAN in Jakarta, Indonesia, in June 2010. Ambassador Kim is the fifth U.S. Ambassador to ASEAN to date.

This is what heat-health action can look like in everyday life. After launching WHO’s new Heat–Health Action Plans Guidance in Berlin, I saw this public drinking water fountain - a simple but important measure that helps people stay safe during hot days. As heatwaves become more frequent and intense, practical actions matter: easier access to drinking water, shaded spaces and cooling centres. Heat is a silent killer. But with the right planning, cities can protect people and save lives. The Guidance is available here: who.int/europe/publications/…

The new Guidance helps authorities anticipate, prepare for and respond to extreme heat – from early warning systems and risk communication to cooling spaces, support for older people and those most at risk, and better preparedness in health and care services. Our ambition is bold: zero heat-related deaths. We have the knowledge. We have the roadmap. Together, we can achieve it. Grateful to Germany for hosting today’s launch and for its continued support to the WHO European Centre for Environment, Climate Change and Health in Bonn, which led this important work. I also thank 🇪🇺 Commissioner Hoekstra and his Directorate-General for Climate Action for providing funding for this vital work. The Guidance is available here: who.int/europe/publications/… 2/2

Today in Berlin, we launched WHO’s new Heat–Health Action Plans Guidance – a practical roadmap to help countries, regions and cities protect people from extreme heat. I was pleased to launch it together with 🇩🇪Federal Environment Minister @schneidercar and Berlin Senator Dr Ina Czyborra, as well as 🇪🇺 Commissioner @WBHoekstra and @UN Assistant Secretary-General @SelwinHart, who joined us online. Europe is warming faster than any other continent. More than 200,000 people across the Region have died from heat in just the past 4 years. We can prevent these deaths with the right systems in place. The Guidance is available here: who.int/europe/publications/… 1/2

📍Sofia -- An excellent opportunity for an engaging and forward-looking fireside chat at the @ECFR event on “EU Enlargement and the Western Balkans”, hosted by Vessela Tcherneva and the Embassy of Albania in Bulgaria. 🇦🇱🇧🇬 Our discussion focused on the renewed momentum behind EU #enlargement and the place of the Western Balkans in an increasingly complex and rapidly evolving geopolitical environment. I was pleased to share #Albania’s perspective on the opportunities and responsibilities that come with this new phase of the enlargement process, as well as the significant progress our country has made on its path towards #EU membership. In today’s strategic context, enlargement is no longer viewed solely as a policy of transformation. It has become a strategic investment in Europe’s security, stability, competitiveness, and long-term resilience. The lessons of recent years have made it clear that a stronger, more united, and geopolitically capable Europe cannot be fully achieved without the integration of the #WesternBalkans into the EU. I emphasized that Albania’s EU accession process, now entering its most decisive and consequential phase, is far more than a foreign policy objective. It is a national aspiration that enjoys broad and enduring support across the political spectrum and throughout Albanian society. Driven by an ambitious reform agenda and a strong commitment to delivering tangible results, our European journey reflects not only institutional transformation but also a clear national and societal choice about the future we want to build. I also underlined that a credible, merit-based enlargement process is in the interest of both candidate countries and the EU itself. #Albania remains fully focused on and committed to maintaining the current momentum, accelerating reforms, and advancing decisively through the negotiation process. Our objective is ambitious but realistic: to conclude accession negotiations by 2027 and achieve full membership by 2030. My sincere thanks to ECFR, @vtcherneva, and all participants for a thoughtful and stimulating exchange. #Horizon2030 -- Një mundësi e shkëlqyer për një bisedë permbjatësore në aktivitetin e @ECFR mbi “Zgjerimin e BE-së dhe Ballkanin Perëndimor”, organizuar nga Vessela Tcherneva dhe Ambasada e Shqipërisë në Bullgari. 🇦🇱🇧🇬 Diskutimi u përqendrua tek rëndësia që ka marrë procesi i #zgjerimit të BE-së dhe te vendi që zë Ballkani Perëndimor në një mjedis gjeopolitik gjithnjë e më kompleks dhe në ndryshim të shpejtë. Pata kënaqësinë të ndaj perspektivën e #Shqipërisë mbi mundësitë dhe përgjegjësitë që sjell kjo fazë e re e procesit të zgjerimit, si edhe mbi progresin domethënës që vendi ynë ka arritur në rrugën drejt anëtarësimit në #BE. Në kontekstin e sotëm strategjik, zgjerimi nuk shihet më vetëm si një politikë transformimi. Ai është shndërruar në një investim strategjik për sigurinë, stabilitetin, konkurrueshmërinë dhe qëndrueshmërinë afatgjatë të BE-së. Zhvillimet e viteve të fundit e kanë bërë të qartë se një Evropë më e fortë, më e bashkuar dhe më e aftë për t’u përballur me sfidat gjeopolitike nuk mund të realizohet plotësisht pa integrimin e #BallkanitPerëndimor në Bashkimin Europian. Theksova se procesi i anëtarësimit të Shqipërisë në BE, i cili po hyn në fazën e tij më vendimtare dhe më përcaktuese, është shumë më tepër sesa një objektiv i politikës së jashtme. Ai është një aspiratë kombëtare që gëzon mbështetje të gjerë dhe të qëndrueshme në të gjithë spektrin politik dhe në mbarë shoqërinë shqiptare. I udhëhequr nga një axhendë ambicioze reformash dhe nga një angazhim i palëkundur për të prodhuar rezultate konkrete, rrugëtimi ynë europian pasqyron jo vetëm transformimin e institucioneve, por edhe një zgjedhje të qartë kombëtare dhe shoqërore për të ardhmen që duam të ndërtojmë. Po ashtu, nënvizova se një proces zgjerimi i besueshëm dhe i bazuar në meritë është në interes si të vendeve kandidate, ashtu edhe të vetë Bashkimit Evropian. #Shqipëria mbetet plotësisht e angazhuar për të ruajtur rritmin aktual, për të përshpejtuar reformat dhe për të avancuar me vendosmëri në procesin e negociatave. Objektivi ynë është ambicioz, por realist: përmbyllja e negociatave të anëtarësimit deri në vitin 2027 dhe anëtarësimi i plotë në Bashkimin Evropianropian deri në vitin 2030. Mirënjohje të sinqertë për ECFR, @vtcherneva dhe të gjithë pjesëmarrësve për këtë shkëmbim mendimesh të vlefshëm dhe frymëzues. #Shqipëria2030

খাগড়াছড়ি জেলার মহালছড়িতে সেনাবাহিনীর ব্যবস্থাপনায় বিনামূল্যে চক্ষু চিকিৎসা প্রদান ও ছানি অপারেশন ঢাকা, ১১ জুন ২০২৬ (বৃহস্পতিবার): গত ০৭ মে ২০২৬ তারিখে পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রামে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর খাগড়াছড়ি রিজিয়নের অন্তর্গত মহালছড়ি জোনের সার্বিক ব্যবস্থাপনায় এবং লায়ন্স হাসপাতালের রোটারী ক্লাবের সহায়তায় একটি বিনামূল্যে চক্ষু চিকিৎসা ক্যাম্পেইন পরিচালিত হয়। উক্ত ক্যাম্পেইনে বিশেষজ্ঞ চিকিৎসকদের মাধ্যমে পাঁচ শতাধিক চক্ষু রোগীর মাঝে চিকিৎসা সেবা সহ বিনামূল্যে ওষুধ বিতরণ এবং প্রথম ধাপে ১৬০ জনকে চশমা প্রদান করা হয়। একই সাথে চোখের বিভিন্ন জটিলতায় আক্রান্ত রোগীদের ছানি (Cataract) অপারেশনের জন্য তালিকাভুক্ত করা হয় । এরই ধারাবাহিকতায়, ক্যাম্পেইনের দ্বিতীয় ধাপে উন্নত চিকিৎসা এবং ছানি অপারেশনের জন্য তালিকাভুক্ত রোগীদের গত ০৮ জুন ২০২৬ তারিখে মহালছড়ি জোনের ব্যবস্থাপনায় ৮৪ জন রোগী চট্টগ্রামের লায়ন্স চক্ষু হাসপাতালে প্রেরণ করা হয়। ৮৪ জন রোগীর এই দলটিতে নারীপুরুষ মিলিয়ে ৪৪ জন বাঙালি এবং ৪০ জন পাহাড়ি ব্যক্তি চিকিৎসাসেবা গ্রহন করেন। এই পর্যন্ত ৫৪ জন রোগীর চোখের ছানি অপারেশন সফলভাবে সম্পন্ন করা হয়েছে। উল্লেখ্য, অপারেশন-পরবর্তী সময়ে রোগীদের চিকিৎসা, নিরাপত্তা, উন্নত আবাসন ও খাবারসহ সকল প্রকার প্রয়োজনীয় সহায়তা নিশ্চিত করতে সেনাসদস্যরা নিরলস দায়িত্ব পালন করেন এবং চিকিৎসা শেষে গত ০৮ জুন ২০২৬ তারিখে রোগীদের নিরাপদে নিজ নিজ এলাকায় পৌঁছে দেন। পাহাড়ি ও বাঙালি জনগোষ্ঠীর মাঝে পারস্পরিক সম্প্রীতি বজায় রাখা এবং সাধারণ মানুষের পাশে দাঁড়িয়ে তাদের জীবনযাত্রার মানোন্নয়নে সেনাবাহিনীর এমন জনকল্যাণমূলক ও মানবিক কার্যক্রম ভবিষ্যতেও অব্যাহত থাকবে। Video

India has 3.7 million dog bites a year. It accounts for 36% of global rabies deaths. In May 2026, the Supreme Court ruled that civic authorities may euthanise rabid or demonstrably aggressive stray dogs, calling the right to walk public spaces without fear a fundamental right under Article 21. Is this a landmark ruling or a shortcut that papers over 65 years of governance failure? Malathi Renati (@MalathiRenati) speaks with Samyukta Hornad (@samyuktahornad), founder of Praana Animal Foundation, a popular Kannada actor and someone who has been doing the unglamorous work of animal welfare since the age of 16. This debate is examined through the Samaaj, Sarkaar, and Bazaar: One number worth sitting with: Lucknow sterilised 84% of its stray population, halved birth rates, and was cited by the SC as India's national benchmark. The event convened a distinguished gathering of policymakers, academics, industry professionals, FPO leaders, and market experts to deliberate on one of the most consequential challenges confronting Indian agriculture today: How can India reform its agricultural marketing system to ensure fair price discovery, effective risk management, and higher farmer incomes? We were honoured by the presence of Dr. Ashok Lahiri (Vice Chairman, NITI Aayog) and Dr. S. Mahendra Dev (Chairman, Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister) as Chief Guests, with special remarks by Dr. Ramesh Chand. Discussions led by Dr. Ashok Gulati, alongside eminent panelists from government, academia, agri-business, commodity exchanges, FPOs, and digital agriculture, made for a rich and substantive dialogue. Among the central themes explored: 🌾 Crop-specificity and regional dimension of procurement 📈 Price risk management and the role of agri-derivatives 🤝 FPO strengthening and value-chain integration 💻 Digital infrastructure, AgriStack, AI, and supply chain traceability 🚜 Technology-driven solutions and market accessibility 🌍 Positioning Indian agriculture within competitive global value chains Rooted in empirical evidence across seven commodity markets, the book examines market structures, price dynamics, MSP frameworks, futures markets, digital platforms, and emerging technologies — charting a credible course toward a more competitive and farmer-centric agricultural economy in India. The IAEA has been informed that, for the 19th time since the beginning of the military conflict, the Zaporizhzhya NPP lost all off-site power at around 21:00 local time last night following an attack on an electrical substation on the other side of the Dnipro River. This latest loss of the Ferosplavna‑1 330 kV back up line comes as the plant prepares repairs on the 750 kV Dniprovska main power line — disconnected since 24 March — under the sixth localized ceasefire agreed with both sides to help restore a second off-site power connection. Operating with only one remaining power line leaves the plant extremely vulnerable to conflict-related grid disruptions as we experience it again today. The ZNPP is currently relying on emergency diesel generators to power the cooling of its six shut-down reactors and maintain other essential nuclear safety functions. The latest loss of off-site power once again highlights the extreme fragility of the electrical grid and the constant dangers to nuclear safety during the war, DG @rafaelmgrossi said, reiterating the urgent need for military restraint to prevent a nuclear accident.

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today met with Vice President of Huawei Asia Pacific, Mr. Peter Pan Junfeng, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. During the meeting, Huawei expressed its appreciation to the ASEAN Secretariat for the strong relationship and meaningful engagements established over the years. Mr. Peter Pan Junfeng also introduced Mr. Vincent Xu Ke, the incoming Vice President of Huawei Asia Pacific, who will further strengthen Huawei’s collaboration with ASEAN moving forward.

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today received a courtesy call from H.E. Sheikh Abdul Karim Harelimana, Ambassador of Rwanda to the Republic of Indonesia, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Both sides exchanged views on ways to enhance cooperation between ASEAN and Rwanda.

The Ambassador of the United States of America to ASEAN, H.E. Yeouk Kim, today presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Kim on the commencement of his tenure and reaffirmed the importance of the ASEAN-United States (U.S.) Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in advancing peace, stability, and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific region. He highlighted the U.S.’s longstanding engagement with ASEAN and appreciated its unwavering support for ASEAN Centrality and ASEAN Community-building efforts, regional economic integration, digital transformation, and development initiatives. Secretary-General Dr. Kao underscored the significance of ASEAN-led mechanisms, including the East Asia Summit (EAS), ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF), and the ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus), in fostering dialogue, mutual trust, and cooperation on regional and global issues of common concern. He highlighted that the U.S. has been a steadfast partner and actively participated in these mechanisms. Ambassador Kim reaffirmed the United States’ support for ASEAN centrality and expressed readiness to deepen cooperation in support of the ASEAN-United States Leaders’ Joint Vision Statement to Promote Stronger, Safer, and More Prosperous ASEAN and America adopted in 2025. Ambassador Kim noted the United States is a proud Pacific nation and highlighted opportunities for expanded partnership to advance a free and open Indo-Pacific that benefits our combined one billion people. He also welcomed the upcoming 50th anniversary of ASEAN-U.S. Dialogue Relations in 2027. The U.S. became a Dialogue Partner of ASEAN in 1977 and established a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with ASEAN in 2022. Reflecting its longstanding commitment to ASEAN, the U.S. established its dedicated Mission to ASEAN in Jakarta, Indonesia, in June 2010, and appointed its first dedicated Ambassador to ASEAN in 2011. Ambassador Kim is the fourth dedicated U.S. Ambassador to ASEAN to date.

'I love the inflation,' Trump says as prices rise amid Iran war President Donald Trump on Wednesday appeared to embrace data showing inflation has risen more than ‌4%, telling reporters that he "loved" inflation and reiterating his belief that prices will fall as soon as the Iran war ends. Asked about U.S. government data showing consumer inflation increased at its fastest pace in three years in May, and whether it could hobble his ​fellow Republicans just months ahead of November's midterm election, Trump said: "I love the inflation." The president then explained ​how he greenlit a plan to secretly move oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz over ⁠concerns of higher costs and increasing inflation. "It was worth it to me," Trump said about his calculus and calling ​the operation a success. "When it's over, you will see oil drop to where it was before," Trump said of ​the larger war. "It's coming down. It's going to come down like a rock." Trump has called the war on Iran a detour and framed it as a national security issue as Tehran's closure of the key shipping route has pushed up the cost of gasoline, fertilizer ​and other goods, contributing to inflation. U.S. President Donald Trump speaks in the Oval Office as he signs the Secure America Act, at the White House in Washington, D.C., U.S., June 10, 2026. REUTERS/Evan Vucci Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab Higher prices could also keep the U.S. Federal Reserve from cutting interest rates, which ​could lower borrowing costs, which Trump has called for since returning to power last year. Republicans are seeking to maintain control of ‌the U.S. ⁠House of Representatives and the Senate but are concerned a consumer backlash could hand the reins to Democrats as the cost of living remains a top issue for voters. Trump himself won the 2024 presidential election in large part because of his promise to lower inflation, but has since seen his approval rating, including on his handling of the cost of living, ​fall to the lowest level ​of his political career. Efforts to ⁠reopen the Strait of Hormuz to tanker traffic to move goods have so far stalled, with industry executives and analysts warning that coming weeks could see another oil price shock ​severe enough to shake the broader financial markets. Even if Trump and Tehran reach a ​deal soon, ⁠it is expected to take months to get supplies moving, with the disruptions expected through 2026. And while Americans may be more insulated from fuel shocks than other nations, ongoing higher energy prices could dent consumer spending over time. Last month, Trump said ⁠Americans' financial ​struggles were not a factor as he pushes for a deal ​even while threatening renewed attacks on Iran: "I don’t think about Americans’ financial situation. I don’t think about anybody. I think about one thing: We ​cannot let Iran have a nuclear weapon." - REUTERS #SamaaTV

So in the 70s, Iravatham Mahadevan (the world authority on the Brahmi and Indus scripts) used to visit TIFR Bombay because it was the only place in India where he could get the computers he needed for his work. And during one of those visits, the head of the computer facility there introduced him to Xerxes Desai of Tata Press, who was casting about for the Tata Group's next venture. It is their conversation over lunch that eventually got the Tatas into watches, as Mahadevan also happened to be heading a Government task force on watch manufacturing at the time. جامعه‌ی افغانستان یک جامعه‌ی قوم‌گرا و دین‌زده است. قوم‌گرایی در افغانستان از حد برچسب سیاسی و ابزار رقابت در میدان قدرت فراتر رفته و به نهاد اجتماعی مبدل شده است؛ به‌گونه‌ای که در افغانستان مردم با قومیت زندگی می‌کنند، رویا می‌بینند و جان‌شان را در راه آن قربانی می‌کنند. دین‌زدگی را هم می‌شود با حضور گسترده‌ی ملاهایی در ساختار نهادهای حکومتی و اجتماع مشاهده کرد (سید عبدالقیوم سجادی، جامعه‌شناسی سیاسی افغانستان). گروه طالبان با روایت قبیله‌ای از اسلام حنفی و تکیه بر عرف پشتون‌والی قوم‌گرایی، دین‌زدگی و انحصار قدرت سیاسی و نظامی را به اوج رسانده و کشور را به بن‌بست کشانده‌اند. لذا می‌توان گفت جامعه‌ی افغانستان با ویژگی‌های قوم‌گرایی و دین‌زدگی زمینه و امکان شکل‌گیری گفتمان طالبانی را فراهم کرده است. ولی طالبان با سیاست‌گذاری‌های خود این دو ویژگی را به بالاترین حد آن رسانده‌اند. بیشتر بخوانید: storage.googleapis.com/quriu…

These overseas operators went to extreme lengths to manufacture an illusion of corporate legitimacy to prey on defense professionals. Posing as legitimate international firms under names like Centrik Global Consulting, GeoIndopacific, and Pulse Wave Global, the suspected spies used stolen identities, fabricated legal contracts, and encrypted apps like Telegram to execute their schemes. Unsuspecting targets were initially offered massive financial compensation to write seemingly benign research reports on sensitive global topics like U.S.-China relations and Middle East conflicts. Once the targets were financially hooked, the recruiters aggressively shifted tactics, pressuring the workers into violating their oaths by handing over exclusive, non-public information. U.S. counterintelligence officials emphasized that this operation aligns with severe warnings from the global Five Eyes intelligence alliance regarding hostile foreign adversaries exploiting professional networking sites. CENTCOM frames it as self defence after the Apache shoot down. 💡Degrading Iran's grip on Hormuz doesn't reopen Hormuz. It makes reopening HARDER. Every strike shrinks the political space for the confidence-building both sides need to restart 5–10M bpd of flows. Less control ≠ more oil 🛢️The inventory hole Meanwhile the math compounds: OECD stocks heading toward ~2.3B bbl — multi-decade lows. Shell's CEO puts the cumulative deficit at 1.0–1.2B barrels, a year+ to rebuild even if things improve tomorrow. Every week of escalation digs the hole deeper. So the curve tells the real story: front-month supported, backwardation steepening but the long end stays capped. Why? The market still believes in Fujairah 2027, Guyana, Brazil, US shale. The stress window is 2026–27 These strikes don't price barrels offline. They price TIME how long the world runs on draining inventories. Duration, not disruption, is the trade. Watch the calendar, not the headlines.

Germany's Cobra 600 is essentially a flying missile rail. It copies the Shahed-136's A2A concept already demonstrated in Ukraine. It is armed with a single IRIS-T missile and comes equipped with 2x JetCat P1000 PROs for propulsion. These put out 1100N max thrust each. Compare the P1000 to the SoluNox engines made in Pakistan, which range to about 800N per their official literature. Perhaps it was last year that I posted that these engines could enable maneuverable, nearly-attritable loyal wingmen. Now you see below what one of these might look like. Another point of consideration is engine price. Chinese engines generating 1100N of thrust are ~$10K when bought in quantities of one(!). This is an illustration of how competition has shifted from platforms to cost + production capabilities. A reasonable cost estimate of an equivalent Chinese or Iranian "flying missile rail" is perhaps $50K. Here is info on the JetCat: jetcat.de/en/productdetails/… 1/2

I do not feel comfortable to say a word in defense of Trump's actions, but he should not be blamed for killing NATO. He has buried it, but the alliance effectively died when Obama in 2014 and, especially, Biden in 2022 refused to unleash its power to stop naked Russian aggression against free Europe -- the only purpose this organization was formed for back in 1949. Miles Taylor (@MilesTaylorUSA) Donald Trump has effectively killed NATO, at least for now. He didn't have to tear up a treaty or fire a shot. Here's the proof: A new poll shows the number of Europeans who see America as an "ally" has plummeted 50% since Trump came back into office. NINE out of TEN of our closest friends no longer see us as a friend at all. Put another way, the world's most consequential alliance has been effectively cut in half in 18 months. Some folks might say this is a "mood" that will pass, but they're wrong. Alliances aren't built on paper. They're built on one belief, i.e. that when the worst comes, your friends will come for you. That same survey found majorities in every European country now doubt America would defend them if attacked. If you don't know anything about international relations, let me tell you: this is basically the heart of the NATO alliance. It's now got a stake in it. Article 5 is the promise our allies invoked to run to our side after 9/11. They officially no longer believe we'd return the favor. Trump may not grasp what that means. But trust me, Vladimir Putin does. Xi Jinping does. Russia and China see how weak Trump has made America and the West. Donald Trump is headed to France next week for a G7 summit... and I hope our allies read him the riot act. If they don't, they should be prepared to write NATO's eulogy. Conversei hoje com a presidenta do México, @Claudiashein. Revisamos os avanços registrados nos compromissos de cooperação e diálogo político assumidos por nossos governos nos últimos meses. Destacamos as produtivas tratativas relacionadas à agenda de cooperação energética, que abrange desde a colaboração em biocombustíveis até a eventual assinatura de um instrumento entre a Pemex e a Petrobras. Também concordamos em aprofundar as conversas sobre o marco jurídico bilateral comercial. Reconhecemos os avanços na colaboração nas áreas de saúde, turismo, governança pública e em ações voltadas ao fortalecimento dos setores científico, tecnológico e de inovação em ambas as nações. Reafirmamos a importância e o valor que atribuímos ao fortalecimento e à preservação do multilateralismo, do direito internacional, da democracia e do princípio da não ingerência, particularmente no complexo contexto global atual. Confirmamos nossa posição a favor do fim do embargo a Cuba e compartilhamos nossa preocupação com a grave situação humanitária no país caribenho. Instruímos nossas chancelarias a realizar, em data próxima, a VI Reunião da Comissão Binacional México–Brasil, com o objetivo de concretizar as diferentes iniciativas. Reiteramos o apoio do México e do Brasil à candidatura de Michelle Bachelet ao cargo de próxima Secretária-Geral das Nações Unidas. México e Brasil são parceiros fundamentais na América Latina e no Caribe, cujo porte e relevância em termos de população, economia e projeção internacional constituem um motor de integração regional e de prosperidade compartilhada para seus povos. Desejei à presidenta Sheinbaum muito sucesso na realização da Copa do Mundo FIFA de 2026 no México, um dos três países-sede do torneio.

📲 Saviez-vous que dans iOS 27, Apple a prévu une liste de pays où le chiffrement des messages RCS (SMS) est interdit ? Chine 🇨🇳. Corée du Sud 🇰🇷. France 🇫🇷. Le reste du monde déploie l'E2EE, le chiffrement de bout en bout entre iPhone et Android. Une avancée majeure pour la confidentialité de vos SMS. En France, c'est bloqué. Les opérateurs sont prêts techniquement. Ce n'est pas un problème d'infrastructure. C'est un choix politique. Les raisons sont multiples, la France ayant toujours une longueur d'avance pour affaiblir votre sécurité et s'assurer de pouvoir garder un oeil sur vous. Mais l'une des pistes probables : La PNIJ - la Plateforme Nationale des Interceptions Judiciaires. Un outil qui permet à l'État d'accéder à vos communications. Le chiffrement de bout en bout sur ces millions d'échanges quotidiens lui couperait l'accès. Définitivement. Alors notre gouvernement fait tout pour que vous restiez exposés.

Here’s the problem. The liberal political class wants us to treat atrocities like Belfast as single, random, isolated incidents. “Yes, it’s horrific, but don’t overreact,” they say. “Let the police do their job. Justice will be delivered. Let’s remain united,” and so on. But the public can see that such incidents *aren’t* random or isolated. They are, in fact, all the consequence of massive state failure in the area of asylum and immigration. All roads lead back there. That’s why people are angry.. They are sick of the platitudes that get trotted out after each fresh incident. They don’t want to hear them anymore. They know that the decisions of establishment politicians have brought us to this current pass, and they don’t trust those same politicians to fix things, especially when some of them refuse to even recognise that the public’s anger is justified. There has been a huge vibe shift in recent years. Imagine - God forbid - there were another 7/7. Does anyone think the public response would be anything like as restrained as it was then? We are in really dangerous territory. The public don’t want flowers and candles and “Don’t let them divide us.” They want someone who says, “I recognise that the state has failed abjectly. We have allowed far too many people to settle in the country without knowing who they truly are. It has disrupted your communities. Your anger is justified. And I will do everything in my power to put things right.” Any politician unwilling to articulate that message, fully and sincerely, is effectively sanctioning more years of growing social disharmony and discord. Things cannot heal until those in power recognise the extent of the problem and what it will take to fix it. And, on both counts, most of them don’t. That’s why the next few years are going to be very, very turbulent.

NEW: malware developers added nuclear & biological weapons text to to their spyware. Goal? To trigger LLM safety refusals... so that their spyware wouldn't be analyzed by an AI security scanner. Cleanest practical example I can think of for why over-indexing on first order safety alignment is risky. When closed (and open) models ship with aggressive refusals, they will be sprinkled with second-order blindspots that attackers will discover...and exploit. We are only in the earliest days of attackers leveraging these features, and it wouldn't surprise me if users systems that need to handle complex cybersecurity issues demand that models be less safety-blunted. In the weeds: @SocketSecurity's post also shows why intention matters in how you design a malware analysis pipeline to avoid prompt manipulation. H/T to colleagues that shared this with me socket.dev/blog/mini-shai-hu…

#WATCH | Delhi: While discussing her debut movie 'Daadi Ki Shaadi', Actor Riddhima Kapoor Sahni speaks about her bond with her late father Rishi Kapoor. She says, "My father was very protective... a lot of people might think, 'Oh, he wouldn't let us join films or work,' but that wasn't the case. When I wanted to go abroad to pursue further studies... I told my father that I wanted to study further and do it in the UK. He was very stressed about the idea of ​​his daughter going to the UK alone, living alone, and wondering how it would work out. He paced up and down for half an hour, just thinking and thinking. He used to get very stressed whenever something different or new came up, like the kids going away. I was maybe 16-17 at the time, but he let me go. He said, 'You do what you like, and I know you’ll give it your 100% in whatever you do.' He was very confident about that. Back then, and even now, if I had told Dad, 'I want to do this film, I’ll make you proud, you guide me, and I’ll be doing it with Mom,' he never would have stopped me. He would have been right there, guiding me. I know that because I knew my father; that’s why." (10.06) Video

About 11 years ago, with our very talented Annapurna team and informed by the unusual scale and insight we had in operating the largest cloud infrastructure, we decided to design and build our own CPU chip. This CPU chip is now known as Graviton, and is well-loved by our AWS customers. About 98% of our top 1,000 EC2 customers use Graviton expansively. Over 120,000 customers are using Graviton. Meta just committed to tens of millions of Graviton cores for their agentic AI efforts. Uber and Snowflake are deploying Graviton as well. Today, we released Graviton5 into General Availability. The reason customers are so excited about Graviton is that it offers about 30-40% better price-performance than comparable instances. This is a big deal at any scale. But, when you layer on top of how much CPU customers normally use with the fact that AI’s growth is driving explosive CPU expansion given that post-training, reinforcement learning, and agentic actions use CPU, Graviton becomes even more compelling. Excited for how Graviton5 will help customers. aboutamazon.com/news/aws/aws…

Graviton5 delivers up to 25% higher performance than the previous generation, with 192 cores per chip and 33% lower inter-core latency. Its efficient design meets the needs of agentic AI workloads that demand real-time reasoning, code generation, and complex, always-on processing. The results speak for themselves: apps run 35% faster, machine learning inference is 35% faster, databases are 30% faster. ✅ 120,000+ customers are already building on Graviton. The cloud just got a serious upgrade. Video

Concluding my visit to #Ireland, I had the opportunity to meet with several of @IFAD’s long-standing partners in Ireland and discuss how we can advance our shared work on food security, rural transformation and resilient food systems. In my meetings with @martinheydonfg, Minister for @agriculture_ie, Members of the Joint Committees on Agriculture and Foreign Affairs and Trade we discussed the importance of investing in rural markets, employment and resilience. I valued the opportunity to engage with Irish government partners. Their engagement matters. Food security is directly linked to climate, economic and conflict related shock. Investment in food security and rural transformation present an important opportunity for economic prosperity and stability. Ireland is an important and long-standing partner for IFAD. Its priorities are closely aligned with IFAD’s mandate and with the focus of #IFAD14. Out partnership shows what effective multilateral finance can do when it is focused, country-led and linked to clear results. IFAD’s work is practical. We invest in rural people so they can increase incomes, access markets, adapt to climate shocks and build stronger local economies. Between 2022 to 2024, IFAD-supported investments increased the incomes of 49 million rural people by an average of 34%. Market access and agricultural production also improved for tens of millions more. IFAD14 is about scaling what works. Connecting capital with results, strengthening rural economies and building resilience where food systems begin. @dfatirl @GovIE #FinancingTheFirstMile

Professional surfer Matt Wilkinson had a close encounter with a shark while surfing near Ballina, New South Wales, on Wednesday, October 7. A Surf Life Saving NSW drone alerted Wilkinson with a recorded message as the shark circled near him off Sharpes Beach. “I was surfing out the back at Sharpes Beach and just cruising on my own and I heard a splash and a noise and looked around and couldn’t see anything,” said Wilkinson. “Then the drone came down and told me that there was a dangerous shark in the area, return to the beach. “I got to the shore feeling a bit weird and the lifeguards showed me the footage and I realised how close it came without knowing it was there. It looks like it’s going for my leg and it’s changed its mind,” he added. The beach was closed after the incident. Drone operator Beau Monks said he’d just launched his seventh drone flight of the day when he spotted the shark near Wilkinson. “It sort of came out of nowhere, then went right up to Matt. It moved pretty fast. I was tracking it and notified the lifeguards and used the speaker on the drone to get everyone out of the water. Within 10 seconds it was at the surfer and five seconds later it was gone,” said Beau Monks. Surf Life Saving NSW operates drones at 34 beaches across New South Wales. Video

🌋 46 years ago today, Mount St. Helens forever changed the Pacific Northwest — and the science of volcano monitoring. After more than a century of quiet, earthquakes and rising magma signaled that pressure was building beneath the volcano in the spring of 1980. On the morning of May 18, the mountain’s north flank collapsed in a massive landslide, triggering a devastating lateral blast that flattened 230 square miles of forest. Ash rose high into the atmosphere and drifted across the U.S, while volcanic mudflows, known as lahars, surged through nearby valleys to the Columbia River. Fifty-seven people lost their lives, including USGS volcanologist David A. Johnston. When the eruption ended, Mount St. Helens stood nearly 1,300 feet shorter than before. The eruption transformed not only the landscape, but also how scientists monitor and prepare for volcanic hazards around the world. ➡️ Watch USGS scientists recount their experiences before, during, and after the eruption: ow.ly/bX0250Z0V4G 📸: Mount St. Helens erupting above a quiet rural landscape, with ash and steam billowing into the sky. I’m honestly surprised this has not received more attention in Europe. The most vivid public example was around the EU’s northeastern flank, with Poland and the Baltic region among the most affected areas. To my knowledge, this may be the first publicly documented wartime case of a space-based EW capability being demonstrated or tested. Lukasz Olejnik (@lukOlejnik) GPS and GNSS interference over Europe is starting to look like something far more serious than local outages, random radio noise, or classic ground-based jamming. Part of it may be linked to active electromagnetic emissions from Russian satellites. If that assessment holds, this is no longer just a technical issue. It becomes a question of national security, infrastructure resilience, and policy toward systems that are critical in aviation, shipping, energy, telecommunications, military operations, and precise timing. Researchers analyzed data from ground-based GNSS stations and found short interference pulses appearing at the same time across a vast area, from Europe to Greenland and Canada. That scale does not fit a local source on the ground. It points to an object high above Earth, with the geometry needed to illuminate a large part of the continent. The signal appeared very close to GPS L1, the core GPS band used by millions of civilian receivers. Its peak was around 1577.5 MHz, while GPS L1 sits at 1575.42 MHz, with a bandwidth of roughly 5 MHz. The data also showed a second burst around 1558.5 MHz, in a band used by China’s BeiDou system. In practice, receivers saw simultaneous drops in signal quality across GPS, Galileo, and BeiDou, in some places by about 10 dB. The key attribution to Russian Cosmos 2546 satellite came from comparing the arrival time of the pulse at two stations. Researchers used that time difference to define a quasi-hyperboloid surface in space, meaning the surface on which the source of the emission had to be located. When they compared that surface with the orbits of suspect objects, the best match was Kosmos 2546, a Russian early-warning satellite in a Molniya orbit. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/lukOlejnik/status/2064223171008463041#m

New credentials attack on Google, it's a subtle one. The email actually comes from account.google.com. It informs you that your recovery contact (an email you don't recognize) is about to reset your password and prompts you to take action. There's a link that appears to point to accounts.google.com but uses the continue URL parameter to redirect you to sites.google.com, which hosts the attacker's site. If you scroll down, you can see the bottom of the email, which just shows that someone is asking to add you as their recovery contact. The entire first part of the email is a user-controlled field in Google's system that the attacker controlled to include the malicious link and text.

Traffic was held up in a North Carolina national park as adorable bear cubs were play-fighting in the road. The incredible moment in Pisgah National Forest was caught on camera by Madelyne Voreh. In the video, three cubs can be seen playfully wrestling and chasing each other with mama bear nearby. Drivers are patiently waiting in their cars to allow the family to enjoy their time. “It honestly felt like one of those once-in-a-lifetime wildlife encounters,” Voreh told Storyful. “Watching the cubs interact with each other while their mother kept an eye on them was incredibly special and is something I’ll remember for a very long time,” she said. She added: “My hope is that any coverage of the video also helps educate people about responsible wildlife viewing. These bears were observed from a safe and respectful distance, and everyone who stopped to watch remained in their vehicles and gave the animals plenty of space. “The Blue Ridge Parkway is the bears’ home, and moments like this are a great reminder to slow down, be patient, and respect wildlife when visiting the area.” Video

That is not an accident. That is not an accident. 1. An investigation by ThePrint revealed that 6 Pakistani Earth-observation satellites were launched in the past 16 months. These spy satellites are also positioned to provide Pakistan with continuous imagery of Indian territory. #CutTheClutter, with my colleague Soumya Pillai who broke the story, explains how Pakistan is reviving its space programme, its strategic importance & what it means for India as well as for ISRO. 2. Pakistan’s launch of these 6 satellites is unprecedented, given that for years it averaged 1 or 2 satellite launches annually. These were launched between January 2025 & June 2026, & all are placed in Sun-synchronous orbits that make them ideal for surveillance. This allows them to pass over the same locations at roughly the same time each time, which makes it easier to compare images & detect changes on the ground. 3. One of the most important satellites was the 4th one, launched in October 2025 — the HS1, Pakistan’s first hyperspectral satellite. This is significant to strategic affairs because it has very advanced imaging facilities. Anything camouflaged, like military assets or military movements along the border, can be caught by it. And, it is not sensitive to weather. The imagery produced can distinguish between different materials & spot structural changes on the ground. 4. In the latest satellite launch — PRSC-EO3 on April 25 — an alteration was made in the orbit. This optimises repeated observation of a narrower geography. In this case, all of Pakistan & the northern territory of India, especially focusing on J&K. What this means is the satellite can make multiple passes over that same region. For instance, if a usual satellite covers the area once in 15 days, this satellite provides the advantage of covering that area multiple times in a day. 5. Pakistan is not overtaking ISRO, which is light years ahead. But what’s important to note is that Pakistan understands the strategic importance of space as a frontier for its strategic advancement & they are trying to catch up. SUPARCO spent years overshadowed by India’s spectacular achievements. Now Islamabad appears determined to rebuild capability, using smaller satellites, foreign launch services & strong Chinese support. 6. New York has passed a new law, the first of its kind in the United States, requiring clear labels on news content made with AI The law, called the NY FAIR News Act, states that any news story, weather report, sports update, entertainment article, or similar content must display a prominent, easy-to-see notice if it was mostly created by AI. The rule applies across all formats, including newspapers, websites, TV, radio, podcasts, images, and videos. The notice must appear at the top so readers or viewers immediately know whether a human reporter wrote it or if AI did most of the work. The State Senate and Assembly approved the bill on June 8, 2026 and now awaits Governor Kathy Hochul’s signature. If signed, the law will take effect 60 days later The rule does not apply to content that includes enough human work to qualify for copyright protection. There are no fines for individuals only the state attorney general can enforce the law against companies that violate it.

What happens when rural youth are given the tools to build their own future? With 1.2 billion young people worldwide – nearly 89% in developing countries – targeted investment in rural youth is a strategic imperative. That is why IFAD invests in youth following a tailored 3Es approach: 🔹Employment – creating decent, stable jobs in agri-food value chains 🔹Entrepreneurship – fostering youth-led start-ups and scaling existing youth-owned businesses 🔹Empowerment – enabling young women and men to participate in decision-making at local, national and global levels The results speak for themselves: In #Cameroon, the Youth Agropastoral Entrepreneurship Promotion Programme offered fully subsidized education, blended financing and start-up coaching to young entrepreneurs, as well as zero-interest start-up loans and productive credit. The programme delivered: ✔️ 20% higher food security ✔️ 48% increase in annual income ✔️ US$3,000 avg annual profit, with 38% annual growth Learn how IFAD invests in rural youth at bit.ly/4xgGQty #FinancingTheFirstMile #IFADImpact

मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांची संवेदनशीलता; अडचणीतील शेतकरी कुटुंबाला तातडीने बैल व नुकसान भरपाई मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी लातूर जिल्ह्यातील भूमिहीन शेतकरी काशिनाथ गायकवाड यांच्यावर ओढवलेली बिकट परिस्थिती समजताच त्यांना तातडीने मदत केली. वीज पडून बैल दगावल्याने पत्नीला जोखडाला जुंपण्याची वेळ आलेल्या या शेतकरी कुटुंबाला अवघ्या काही तासांत एक बैल आणि दगावलेल्या बैलाच्या नुकसानभरपाईची रक्कम मिळाली आहे. लातूर जिल्ह्यातील देवणी तालुक्यातील बोंबळी खुर्द येथील शेतकरी काशिनाथ गायकवाड यांच्याकडे असणाऱ्या बैलाचा शुक्रवारी (5 जून) झालेल्या वादळी पावसात वीज पडून मृत्यू झाला. त्यामुळे काशिनाथ यांना शेतीची कामे पूर्ण करण्यासाठी पत्नी हौसाबाई यांना जोखडाला जुंपावे लागले, हे वृत्त मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्यापर्यंत पोहोचले. यावर मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी लातूरचे जिल्हाधिकारी तसेच सर्व यंत्रणांना तत्काळ मदत करण्याचे निर्देश दिले. त्यानुसार तहसील कार्यालयासह, पशूसंवर्धन, कृषी आदी सर्व यंत्रणा श्री. गायकवाड यांच्यापर्यंत पोहचल्या. पशूसंवर्धन विभागाने प्रयत्नपूर्वक एक बैल उपलब्ध करून घेतला आणि तो जिल्हाधिकारी व संबंधित अधिकाऱ्यांच्या उपस्थितीत थेट गायकवाड कुटुंबियांकडे सुपूर्द केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांच्या या संवेदनशील हाताळणीमुळे गायकवाड कुटुंबाला मोठा दिलासा मिळाला असून त्याबद्दल त्यांनी मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांचे मनःपूर्वक आभार मानले. @Dev_Fadnavis #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis

Fukushima's reactors shut down exactly as designed. Texas's power infrastructure was largely intact. And yet both became catastrophic disasters. Why? Because the failures didn't come from where anyone was looking. A new paper by Mr Tariq Ahmad of the National Maritime Foundation argues that the most consequential disasters in complex systems — ports, power grids, nuclear plants — rarely emerge from direct destruction. They emerge from the quiet collapse of the functions and dependencies holding everything else together. The Indian disaster management planning paradigm needs to institutionalise a function-oriented approach based on systems thinking to achieve resilience of her critical systems and infrastructure. Like Cato the Elder, we should keep returning to the fundamental question: What is the United States' endgame in Iran? First, President Trump can choose to launch additional strikes against Iran. However, there is little reason to believe that such actions would compel Tehran to surrender or abandon what it considers its core red lines. Second, a return to military confrontation would likely further destabilize the global economy and push the prospect of a negotiated agreement farther away rather than bring it closer. Third, even if President Trump is considering renewed military action, it remains difficult to understand the strategic rationale given that the same administration has repeatedly expressed its desire to reach an agreement with Iran. It is possible that the threat of force is intended to increase pressure on Tehran and extract concessions, but there is little evidence that such pressure would alter Iran's fundamental positions. Tehran's red lines are unlikely to change. Fourth, any strike on Iranian infrastructure would almost certainly trigger a significant Iranian response. At the same time, if Washington issues threats that it ultimately does not carry out, it risks further undermining the credibility of its deterrence posture at a moment when Iran has already absorbed substantial setbacks. For that reason, the key question is not whether the United States should strike Iran or refrain from doing so. The real question is how Washington's current policy serves its broader strategic objective. 𝐅𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐡 𝐍𝐚𝐳 We are pleased to announce that Dr. Farah Naz has successfully defended her Ph.D. thesis titled "𝐑𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐏𝐚𝐤𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧: 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐄𝐯𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞." Dr. Farah Naz’s research provides a comprehensive assessment of rural transformation across Pakistan by developing a district-level 𝐑𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐱 (𝐑𝐓𝐃𝐈) and examining its spatial and temporal patterns. The study highlights how factors such as irrigation, agricultural credit, education, infrastructure, and climate conditions shape rural transformation and contribute to regional disparities and development outcomes.
